verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents an official `omarchy` CLI and pitches it as useful when an AI agent helps with customization or configuration, which gives agents a documented programmatic control surface (e.g. `omarchy-snapshot create`, `omarchy windows key`). It is a local command-line interface rather than a formal public API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: a formal documented API or SDK with a published schema (OpenAPI paths all 404), an llms.txt or machine-readable reference, evidence of how much of the system the CLI covers, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving it.
